badge.description: A small label for a status or category.

button.description: A button that can be rendered as another element, or stay focusable while disabled.

dialog.description: A popup that opens on top of the entire page.

field.description: Groups a label, control, and error message; TanStack Form supplies the state.

form.description: A form that validates its fields on submit and focuses the first invalid one.

switch.description: A control that indicates whether a setting is on or off.

toaster.description: A brief message that appears temporarily and stacks with others.
